comments.body: A friend of a friend is from China and managed to find a job in Zug. I believe the most important thing is that you are willing to relocate and are applying to jobs in all of Switzerland, not just the town you're studying in. Also, start ups are probably a good place to start with, especially if the pay isn't high - you will face less competition from Swiss/ C permit applicants. Then, after working there for a while, you'll be able to get a better permit and find a better job if you keep looking.
comments.author: zweiter_mensch
